# django-modern-rest

> > A modern Django REST framework with async support, type-safe serialization using pydantic/msgspec, and automatic OpenAPI schema generation.

django-modern-rest is a Python library that modernizes Django REST API development through Controllers, Endpoints, and Blueprints. It emphasizes type safety, performance, and async capabilities while maintaining compatibility with Django's ecosystem.

## Key Topics

- django-modern-rest
- Django REST framework
- pydantic serialization
- msgspec
- async/await support
- OpenAPI schema generation
- Type-safe APIs
- Controllers and Endpoints
- Blueprint routing
- PydanticSerializer
- Schema validation
- ASGI/WSGI compatibility
- Performance optimization
- REST API design
